item.title: TT-104: Undo
item.brief: In the repository's BACKLOG.md (under tasktracker/), implement ticket TT-104 "Undo" exactly per its acceptance criteria. Use only the Python standard library. Add unit tests for the new behaviour under tests/. Existing tests must pass: `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .`. Make exactly one commit for this ticket, with a message naming TT-104, and do not add any attribution lines to the commit. Stay within the repository.

reasons: sizer: ordinary -> medium; unchanged: the learned route's effort

state.summary:
TT-104 (Undo) implemented in one commit, deb8a68 on archon/3gt4yys0-tt-104-undo, based on 2e4a664. TaskStore now keeps an undo log of add, complete and delete operations; undo() reverts the most recent unundone one (LIFO across kinds). Undoing an add removes the task, undoing a complete restores the previous status, and undoing a delete restores the same Task object under the same id. Ids are never reused. undo() raises NothingToUndo (new, in tasktracker.store) on an empty log, and failed operations are not recorded. Standard library only. Added tests/test_undo.py (7 tests). Check: `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .` gives 11 tests OK on the final head (before: 4 tests OK on 2e4a664). Review: reviewer agt_01M88R3X3MSAXR4TMMS9D8S7QJ passed deb8a68 with no blocking findings. Open follow-up (non-blocking): delete() logs the same Task object it returns, so a caller that mutates the returned task before undo() gets that mutated state back. Copying on delete would give strict snapshot semantics. Assumption: complete is undone by restoring the previous status, not forced to open; this matches the spec for normal open tasks and stays consistent when a done task is completed again. Nothing is left running; no processes were started.

pr.body: Approach: TaskStore keeps an in-memory undo log of (kind, task_id, saved) entries appended by add, complete and delete. undo() pops the last entry: ADDED removes the task, COMPLETED restores the previous status, DELETED reinserts the saved Task object under its id. Ids are not reused because _next_id is never decremented. Failed operations raise before logging. Key files: tasktracker/store.py, tests/test_undo.py. Checks: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t . gives 11 tests OK on deb8a68 (4 existing + 7 new). Assumptions: undoing a complete restores the previous status instead of forcing open. Follow-up: delete logs the same object it returns, so caller mutations before undo() are restored (non-blocking).
pr.summary: Made undo happen. Now can revert the last add, complete or delete, LIFO, via TaskStore.undo(). Before: no undo, now: undo() with NothingToUndo on empty log.

state.summary:
TT-103 (search query syntax) implemented in one commit, 9d68ce2 on archon/mbhhw1sg-tt-103-search-query-syntax, on top of base 2e4a664. tasktracker/search.py now splits the query on whitespace (double quotes group a phrase), ANDs the terms, matches bare words and phrases case-insensitively against titles, supports tag:NAME (exact, case-insensitive) and status:open|done, and raises QueryError for unknown fields, unknown statuses, empty field values and unterminated quotes. evidence.none: Pure library behaviour with no visible or measured output; the unit-test result above is the evidence.

pr.body: Approach: tasktracker/search.py tokenizes the query on whitespace outside double quotes, parses each token into a bare term or a field:value term, and ANDs the matchers. Unknown fields, unknown statuses, empty field values and unterminated quotes raise QueryError(ValueError). Blank queries match everything in input order. Key files: tasktracker/search.py, tests/test_search.py (12 new tests). Checks: unittest discover on the final tree, 17 OK. Assumptions: field names and status values are matched case-insensitively; a colon outside quotes always starts a field term, so a bare word like 12:30 raises QueryError. Limits: no escaping of double quotes inside phrases; a quote may appear mid-token (tag:"x y").
pr.summary: made task search understand a small query language. now can filter by tag:NAME and status:open|done, and use quoted phrases with AND-ed terms. before: case-sensitive substring match on titles, now: case-insensitive, with tag and status filters and QueryError on bad input.
pr.title: TT-103: Add search query syntax

risk.why: Changes the behaviour of the public tasktracker.search.search (case-insensitive, new operators, new exception) in one module, plus new tests. The only existing caller, tests/test_basic.py, still passes. Reviewer confirmed medium.

state.summary:
TT-101 (reject impossible due dates) is implemented in one commit, 01ca1de, on archon/jfhgggrh-tt-101-reject-impossible-due-dates, based on 2e4a664. Nothing is pushed.

What changed: tasktracker/dates.py adds InvalidDate, a ValueError subclass. parse_due now raises it for impossible calendar dates (2026-02-30, 2025-02-29, 2026-04-31, 2026-13-01, 2026-00-10), for unsupported forms (-3d, 3d, bogus, empty, 2026-3-1), and for offsets that overflow the date range. Each message contains the original text. today, tomorrow, +0d, case-insensitive matching and whitespace handling are unchanged. The new tests are in tests/test_dates.py.

Checks: before the change, all five impossible dates were silently clamped and -3d/3d raised a bare ValueError. After the change, each impossible date raises InvalidDate. python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t . reports Ran 11 tests, OK, on head 01ca1de (tree b0cb074967567b880f5228058ecc00445bb52185).
